mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_records ( user_id, execution_item_id, outcome, started_at, ended_at, actual_minutes, completion_percent, note, remaining_execution_item_id ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{executionItemId}, #{outcome}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{actualMinutes}, #{completionPercent}, #{note}, #{remainingExecutionItemId} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.execution_record_id AS executionRecordId, r.execution_item_id AS executionItemId, i.title AS title, i.scheduled_date AS scheduledDate, i.course_id AS courseId, r.outcome AS outcome, r.actual_minutes AS actualMinutes, r.completion_percent AS completionPercent, r.note AS note, r.recorded_at AS recordedAt FROM execution_records r LEFT JOIN execution_items i ON i.execution_item_id = r.execution_item_id AND i.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(r.recorded_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY r.recorded_at DESC, r.execution_record_id DESC
